title: A full Pushy reading day: kickoff, check-in, on it, done
origin: Spec #6 (nudge scheduler), Watch: a full step day

history.text: That's your plan, Maya. It's yours now and I'll hold you to it. Are you in?

plan.reason: Twenty pages a night finishes the book in two weeks.

testerLines: done!! 20 pages, this book is so good
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the daily rhythm on a Pushy step day.
shouldHaveHappened: At 9 am ZOH starts a warm kickoff that uses Maya's name and names her commitment (20 pages of Project Hail Mary, on the couch, at 7) and asks one question. Her reply gets a short answer. Around 6:50 pm a short check-in names the step and says to get set up. "heading to the couch now" gets a short push, no extra question needed. "done!!" gets a real, specific celebration. Nothing after that: no follow-up text later in the evening. No guilt or fake urgency anywhere.
